edits.before: - Yuumi You and Me! (Attach): matchup-defining — Untargetable while attached — kill the host or catch the dismount windows. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Yuumi's W (You and Me!) has no cooldown — she re-attaches the instant she detaches, so kill pressure must land before she reconnects. - Her R (Final Chapter) resets in 120s at rank 1, 100s at rank 3, and any CC you land cancels the channel. - Spend your own R only on a guaranteed kill.
